steps: UI: filled the hosted Create Oracle form (5 s locks) with test wallet m4Ac…: initialize; the page showed the oracle PDA CmAjgQFF…
UI: Submit Value 123.45; the page then read back AGGREGATED 123.45 and LATEST 123.45 from devnet
Script: deposit 300 (A) and 100 (B) weight tokens; this is A's
Script: B submits 160.000000; aggregate becomes 152.500778 (weighted 3:1 with decay) and B is paid a reward from the pool
Script: B (100 of 400 tokens, above the 20% quorum) votes to blacklist A: A is blacklisted
Script: B withdraws 40 tokens after the lock
evidence.functional_evidence: initialize, fund, deposit, submit_value and the recorded rejects all landed. Withdraw and whitelist votes were script-proven.
evidence.ui_check: Driven in headless Chromium with an injected Wallet Standard test wallet (tests/devnet/wallet_click.py orboracle, log tests/devnet/logs/ui-clicks-2026-11-10.jsonl): create, deposit and submit went through the app's own forms and buttons, and the oracle page showed the new value, the 50 unlocked tokens and the authority read from devnet.

limitations: Whitelist votes, withdraw and vote-weight refresh were run from the script, not clicked. The explorer list is read with getProgramAccounts on the public RPC and can be slow.
